title: How is Nikola Tesla connected to The Rock?
description:
Mark Twain, Helen Keller, two first ladies and Mr. T in a Santa suit connect Nikola Tesla to Dwayne Johnson.

Nikola Tesla → Mark Twain → Helen Keller → John F. Kennedy → Jacqueline Kennedy Onassis → Nancy Reagan → Mr. T → Hulk Hogan → The Rock

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Nikola Tesla → Mark Twain: In 1894, Mark Twain visited Tesla's New York lab and held a lamp lit by wireless power.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Twain_in_Tesla%27s_Lab.jpg
2. Mark Twain → Helen Keller: Twain befriended a young Helen Keller, and they posed together at writer Laurence Hutton's home.
   Photo by not stated, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Laurence_Hutton,_Mark_Twain_and_Helen_Keller.jpg
3. Helen Keller → John F. Kennedy: In 1961, Keller visited the White House to meet President John F. Kennedy.
   Photo by Abbie Rowe, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_John_F._Kennedy_Meets_with_Helen_Keller.jpg
4. John F. Kennedy → Jackie Kennedy: A year later, Kennedy and his wife Jackie hosted a White House dinner for France's culture minister.
   Photo by Robert LeRoy Knudsen, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:JBKJFKMalraux.jpg
5. Jackie Kennedy → Nancy Reagan: In 1985, Jackie joined Ronald and Nancy Reagan at a fundraiser for the Kennedy Library.
   Photo by White House Photographer, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Reagans_with_Jackie_Kennedy.jpg
6. Nancy Reagan → Mr. T: Two years earlier, Nancy sat on Santa's lap at the White House, and Santa was Mr. T.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Nancy_Reagan_Sitting_on_Santa_Claus_(Mr._T)_Lap_After_Reviewing_White_House_Chrismas_Decorations_with_The_Press_in_Cross_Hall_-_DPLA_-_a5009f101af564ab6fd26763dddbbc79.jpg
7. Mr. T → Hulk Hogan: In 1985, Mr. T teamed up with Hulk Hogan in the main event of the first WrestleMania.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mr_T_at_WrestleMania,_1985.jpg
8. Hulk Hogan → The Rock: And at WrestleMania 30 in 2014, Hogan went face to face with The Rock.
   Photo by Miguel Discart from Bruxelles, Belgique, CC BY-SA 2.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:WWE_2014-04-06_18-22-41_NEX-6_9458_DxO_(13918972796).jpg

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#nikolatesla #therock #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
